func (*Recorder) Append(ctx context.Context, event RecordedEvent) error
func (*Recorder) Follow(ctx context.Context, after uint64, target duplex.Wire) (*duplex.Follower, error)
func (*clientEvents) Settled(ctx context.Context, data protocol.Outcome) error
func (*clientMethods) Supervise(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Supervise) (protocol.Outcome, error)
func (*serverMethods) Describe(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Ticket) (string, error)
func (*serverMethods) Start(ctx context.Context, params protocol.Start) (protocol.Job, error)
func FromWire(ctx context.Context, wire duplex.Endpoint, environment runtime.AdapterContext) (protocol.ServerModel, error)
func PrepareFromWire(wire duplex.Endpoint, environment runtime.AdapterContext) (complete func(context.Context) (protocol.ServerModel, error), cleanup func(), err error)
func Record(ctx context.Context, target duplex.Endpoint, log duplex.WireLog, options duplex.RecordOptions, environment runtime.AdapterContext) (*Recorder, error)
func ToWire(model protocol.ServerModel, environment runtime.AdapterContext) (duplex.Endpoint, error)
type RecordedEvent interface{recordedEvent()}
type RecordedSettled struct{Data protocol.Outcome}
type Recorder struct{}
